description.text: Program Highlight Themajoristhethirdbestoneintherankofallovercountry. ElectricalEngineeringLevelSubjects(Including 5 second rate disciplines :Electric Machines and Electric Apparatus, Power Electronics and Power Transmission, Power System and its Automation, High Voltage and Insulation Technology, Theory and New Technology of Electrical Engineering) Why SUT? 1. Situated in Shenyang—— a key modern city in the northeast; 2. Engineering oriented comprehensive university; 3. Pure English taught programs; 4. Specifically international students' accommodation with complete facilities; 5. Good climate with distinctively four seasons; 6. Convenient shopping environment. Main Courses Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, Network Theory, ElectromagneticFields, Analog Electronic Technology, Digital Electronic Technology,power electronic technology, Principles of Automatic Control,Electromechanics, Electrical Appliances, Modern InspectionTechnology, Power Engineering, Principles and Application of Mono-Chip Computer, High Voltage Engineering, Comprehensive Chinese,listening, Spoken Chinese Education System Four years Degree Awarded Students who are eligible to obtain a bachelor's degree and undergraduate diploma must successfully complete the prescribed credits delivered by Major Cultivation Program and pass the undergraduate dissertation.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering and Automation at Shenyang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
